title: statusline r1 A11y: glyph-only marks pass every falsification path
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 1. Lens: accessibility (validator: ux). Owner: SO session. Defect: color-stripping is the only non-color falsification; a symbol-only degraded marker or ellipsis truncation mark satisfies it while remaining screen-reader illegible; no criterion requires the marks be legible words. Citations verified: contract:185, :197. Anchors: criteria, renderer. Proposed: deferred (resolves if the accessible-equivalent finding is adopted — full untruncated values and explicit degraded flag live in the machine form). Failure: marked-but-meaningless states for assistive tech.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree (deferred folded into fix pass by operator). Degraded marker and truncation marks contracted as plain words (glyph may accompany, never substitute): Status bullet, renderer properties, and Status detection criterion all updated to worded marks. Revision: three anchors.
